verdict.summary: The change correctly distinguishes independent generation-staleness and usage-probe degradations, renders each as a separate alert line, and annotates the otherwise misleading eligible-capacity figure whenever the published probe marker is unmeasured. The executed DOM-harness assertions are non-vacuous: they cover healthy, fresh-failed, and stale-plus-failed documents; verify exact line counts and both notice texts; and pin the capacity annotation's positive and negative cases. The CSS change matches the new paragraph structure without weakening any trust-plane check or introducing unsafe data handling.
